The function's own docstring justifies the copy by saying llm_client's loader is 'a private helper scoped to the chat-completions path' (kind_classifier.py:120-121), but that is not accurate: `_load_api_key` takes a plain `ServiceConfig` and touches only `service.key_required`/`service.key`/`apiconf.get_key` -- nothing about chat-completions-specific shape -- and it is used by both `complete()` and `health_check()` in llm_client.py, not just the chat path. grep across daemon/src/prismis_daemon confirms `_load_api_key` exists nowhere else in the codebase before this diff: summarizer.py, evaluator.py, deep_extractor.py and context_analyzer.py all go through llm_client.complete() and never touch apiconf key-loading directly. kind_classifier.py is the first module to duplicate it instead of exporting/reusing it (e.g. dropping the leading underscore in llm_client.py and importing it). The duplicate is currently correct and every test passes, but it is a second copy of logic the codebase already holds, contradicting the stakes' explicit instruction, and it will silently drift from llm_client's error messages/exception handling the next time that function changes.

summary: GetDistinctKinds' query (`SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(analysis, '$.kind') ... FROM content WHERE json_valid(analysis) AND json_extract(analysis, '$.kind') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY kind`, added at queries.go:782-793 per the diff) has no `archived_at` scoping, unlike every sibling content query in the same file: GetAllContent (queries.go:339, `showArchived bool` parameter, filters `c.archived_at IS NOT NULL`/`IS NULL`) and queryContentWithFilter (queries.go:198-202) both scope by archive state, and CountUpvotedItems (queries.go:767, right above the new function) filters `archived_at IS NULL` even for a simple count. GetDistinctKinds takes no such parameter and reads across every row regardless of archive state. Consequence: in local (non-remote) mode, the model.go call sites (`db.GetDistinctKinds()`, no argument) populate `m.availableKinds` from kinds that may exist only on archived items, which the default (non-archived) list view never shows. Cycling the "K" hotkey to that kind (model.go's cycling reads `m.availableKinds`) sets `m.kindFilter` to a value no visible item can match, and `applyFiltersClientSide`'s kind check (model.go, the block added right after the archived-view note in the same function) silently returns zero items with no indication why. This is asymmetric with the remote-mode path, where `distinctKindsFromItems` derives kinds from the already-fetched (and therefore already archive-filtered) item slice, so only the local-DB path has this gap. No test in queries_test.go's TestGetDistinctKinds/TestGetDistinctKinds_EmptyDatabase seeds an archived row, so the gap is untested as well as unhandled.

The FILTERS & SORTING section of the help modal (help_modal.go:167-173, untouched by job-6.diff) lists every other list-view filter/toggle this job's sibling filters share a row with -- `1/2/3/4` priority, `0/i` unprioritized/interesting, `a/u/v` all/unread/archived, `d/s` date-sort/source-type -- but the diff adds neither the new `K` hotkey (model.go, the cycling case added after the `s` source-type-cycle case) nor the new `:kind` command (registry.go's `cmdKind`) to this list. Both are new user-facing controls with no other in-app discovery path (no completion/autocomplete for `:` commands is evident in this diff), so a user pressing `?` for help will not learn either exists.
